description: This Swift source file defines data structures and a class for managing a list of nodes (devices or entities) in an application. It includes a struct 'NodeInfo' representing individual node details, a response struct for decoding API responses, and a singleton class 'NodesStore' that handles fetching and updating the node list asynchronously, with logging and control over polling intervals.

classes.name: NodesStore
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing and updating the list of nodes asynchronously, including starting and stopping periodic refreshes, error handling, and logging.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the periodic refresh of node data, using a detached loop with a specified interval.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the periodic refresh of node data.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the latest node list from the server and updates internal state, handling errors and cancellation.

methods.name: isCancelled
methods.description: Checks whether an error is due to a cancellation, used to handle specific error cases during network requests.
